== Introduction ==
There were a total of 64 players signed up for [[Duelmania Reloaded 3]]. Just like the tournaments before this featuring a double elimination bracket.

* Running date: 3rd of November [[2013]] - 22nd of December [[2013]]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/ownage.qw #duelmania] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Website: [http://www.duelmania.net/?sid=3 Duelmania Reloaded Pt. 3]

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[ztndm3]], [[aerowalk]]
* Allowed clients: [[FTEQW]] 1.00 and [[FodQuake]] 0.2 and [[ezQuake]] 2.1 with -ruleset smackdown
* Timelimit 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No powerups
* Discharges on
* No fairpacks
* Ktx2 spawns (unless both players agree on a different mode)
* Maxfps 77
* No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes.
* Fallbunny on.
